metadata.species: Neutropenic rats infected i.p. with 1 × 10^7 CFU; individual septic rats; male/female 50/50. Strain and infecting organism: NOT_FOUND.
metadata.matrix: tail-vein whole blood, used for the underlying concentration measurements; concentrations are not supplied in this table
metadata.exposure_basis: fT > MIC and fT > 4 × MIC, expressed as percentages and determined using measured meropenem concentrations and PK modeling; direct free-concentration measurement and binding-correction definitions: NOT_FOUND
metadata.record_level: Individual-subject reported exposure percentages in four separate regimen columns, with Subject values 1 through 12. Cross-regimen subject identity is not established.
metadata.endpoint_window: Treatment began 2 h after infection and continued "for a period of 12 h". The percentage time denominator is NOT_FOUND. Mortality monitoring for 7 days is described, but mortality results are not provided.
metadata.dosing_regimen: 40%fT > MIC (75 mg/kg/q6h); 100%fT > MIC (75 mg/kg/q2.4h); 100%fT > MIC (50 mg/kg/q2.4h); 100%fT > 4 × MIC (75 mg/kg/q2h). From 2 h after infection, s.c. "for a period of 12 h"; controls got sterile saline.

qualifiers: determined based on the measured meropenem concentrations and PK modeling
